name: tensorflow
description: An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone
one_liner: Google's widely-used open-source toolkit for building and training machine learning models — the plumbing underneath many AI products, not a product itself.
buyer: No direct buyer — it's foundational developer infrastructure that ML engineers use internally, not something a non-technical buyer would purchase.
business_use_cases: An ML engineering team at any company uses it as the core training framework for their in-house models.
A bootcamp or university builds a paid ML course or certification using TensorFlow as the teaching framework.
A cloud provider offers managed TensorFlow training clusters as part of its AI platform offering.

money_ideas.idea: Paid TensorFlow training or certification courses for engineers.
Managed, optimized TensorFlow hosting for teams that don't want to run their own GPU clusters.

steal_this: There's no weekend consumer product here. The only quick move is teaching a paid one-day TensorFlow workshop, not shipping an app.
